_comment: Alignment-loss ablation, warm-started from unified_baseline (leiden_s1_baselines.json).
Every run: same parent weights, 50k steps (epoch_size 10000 x 5 epochs), fresh LR schedule,
class-aware sampler, and the alignment losses it does not train on logged (monitor_losses).
Runs: align_ctrl (+ seed 1 for the noise floor), one per alignment level
(mmd = marginal, contrastive / cdd = class-conditional, paired = instance), the aggregation
pair (align_agg_ctrl draws the same cells, loss_weight_agg 0 only logs the loss), and
align_combo_agg (MMD + contrastive + paired + aggregation). align_combo (the same without
the aggregation loss, cells drawn) is in leiden_s1_alignment_test.json, launched first.
Loss weights (base_config.features) are calibrated, not guessed. Order of launches:
1. --only align_calib: the loss-weight probe (trainer.calibrate_loss_steps), writes
checkpoints/align_calib/loss_balance.json and prints the weights to paste below;
(the loss_weight_* values now in the file are placeholders: 1, CDD 0.3);
2. paste them into base_config.features (loss_weight_*), then
python -m experiments.launch --config experiments/configs/leiden_s1_alignment_test.json;
3. if align_combo trains fine, launch this config (align_calib only re-reads its json).
Each weight gives its term calibrate_target_share x the reconstruction gradient on the
backbone at the parent; a combination applies the sum of the single-run pressures.
Batches (every run, controls included): 128 rows = 51 bulk + 51 pseudobulk + 26 cells; the
class-aware sampler puts 80% of bulk and pseudobulk on 8 shared tissues (~5 rows per tissue
per domain). n_sc_per_pseudobulk 4 for every run: aggregation runs add 4 cells per
pseudobulk (~332 rows) and paired batches 4 cells per pair (51 x 6 = ~306 rows), so the
cell views match across runs. Attention is flex (linear in L; same weights, no
attention-weight dropout in training) with grad_checkpoint. Keep 128 only if align_calib's
peak-memory lines stay <= ~20 GiB; else n_sc_per_pseudobulk 3, then batch_size 96
(bulk/pb ratios kept, class_aware_n_classes 6). The parent trained at 64 rows with mha:
read effects against align_ctrl. Any sampler change needs a new calibration (delete
loss_balance.json).
Paired loss: symmetric InfoNCE over the pairs of a paired batch (paired_loss infonce,
temperature 0.1): each bulk / pseudobulk / cell mean must be closer to its own pair than
to the batch's other pairs; train/paired_top1 tracks it (near 1 = training pairs learned).
align_paired (InfoNCE, the shared weight) vs align_paired_mse (the original MSE): same
batches, only the paired objective differs. align_calib measures both forms on the same
paired batches and prints 'paired forms: ... override loss_weight_paired <w>': set that w
in align_paired_mse's overrides (1.0 there is a placeholder).
Paired runs: paired_sampling also draws a paired batch every 10 steps (the paired loss is
bound to it), so their batches differ from the control's on those steps.
Aggregation loss: align_agg_infonce is align_agg with agg_loss infonce (symmetric InfoNCE: each
pseudobulk must find the mean of its own 4 cells among the batch's other pseudobulks' cell means,
and the reverse; copies of one pseudobulk_id are positives, never negatives). Same batches as
align_agg and align_agg_ctrl; train/agg_top1 is logged by all three. Its loss_weight_agg (4.0)
is a placeholder: first launch --only align_calib_agg_infonce (a probe with only that term on;
the shared weights above stay as calibrated) and set the 'agg' suggestion it prints
(loss_weight_agg) in align_agg_infonce's overrides, then --only align_agg_infonce.
Evaluation: evaluate/configs/leiden_s1_alignment_evaluation.yaml.
